scope: Functional McKernel OS/apps and Rust/assembly migration only; no security testing.
assumption_limit: Model covers the selected status-only control cadence with ordinary QEMU replies and bounded event allowance. It is not an upper bound for arbitrary1MiB replies/byte-fragmented streams; finite raw/encoded/row limits must still fail closed without trimming evidence or altering polling.
review_conditions: LONG raw/encoded/session writer/owner cap/profile/shared capture/growth closure
Retain first ordinary over-budget record before raising; preserve original lifecycle error
Terminalquit uses bounded reserve and restores prior recovery state even on exceptions
Exact serialized list accounting including delimiters; finite row/object memory reasoning
LONG-only bounded postretirement serialization/write deadline; unchanged shortprofile
Fresh actual source-cohort/admission successor required; no newkernel/module/collector/oracle changes
Root-granted small regression tests before source integration/release; none executed by reviewer
